note: Scanned pages are counted as unreadable and excluded from analysis. No OCR was run, so no text on those pages is claimed anywhere.

defines.marks_at_risk: Mean marks exposed per exam in which this mode appears (equal split across exercises, then across task clauses).
defines.marks_per_exam_all: Mean marks exposed per analysed exam, including exams that do not test this mode. Always smaller; shown for context only.

marks_model.note: No document in this corpus states per-exercise points. The split is an assumption, so marks_at_risk is 'marks exposed under an equal split', not a measured quantity.
